title: search-only cycle logs no integrity step -> verifier per-cycle integrity FAIL
root_cause: A search-only cycle (gather phase, process gated off) runs the parallel search+ingest driver, which adds corpus via ingest_flow but never runs check_integrity.py — the integrity step lived only in loop.md step 1 and process step 8. So a cycle with ingest work logged no integrity record and the per-cycle verifier failed it.
fix: goal.md step 3 runs check_integrity.py + logs an integrity record after the parallel search+ingest driver, so every cycle that ingests self-certifies within its own cycle (not deferred to the next cycle's step 1).

title: graphify cluster() crashes on merged graph during loop graph-update
symptom: During the ingest graph-update step, graphify cluster()/to_json raises TypeError: unhashable type: list on the build_merge-merged graph; graph.json is not rewritten and the cycle stalls.
root_cause: graphify cluster() chokes on a node id / attribute that is a list in the merged extraction produced by build_merge for this corpus (graphify-internal, not an engine bug).
fix: Skip community detection for the run: build_from_json(merged_extract) then to_json(G, {0: list(G.nodes())}, ".graphify/graph.json"). Graph nodes/edges still update incrementally; only clustering is bypassed. Revisit when graphify fixes cluster() on merged input.

title: search yields 0 non-junk sources (flaky crawl4ai) -> gap requeued (expected)
root_cause: crawl4ai cold-starts (fail ~half the time on first fetch) and junk/error pages (GitHub 'Uh oh', cookie walls) mean a gap's search yields 0 non-junk sources; search_flow then requeues the gap (failed after 3 attempts). This is the flaky-network path, not a logic bug.
fix: Expected/benign — retry-once + requeue + fail-after-3 already handle it; the WARN is informational. No code change. If a topic repeatedly zeroes out, widen its gap query or check crawl4ai health.
